name: v0.2.28
body:
Nemotron streaming on Apple Silicon, safer API token handling, and a lock fix that unblocks Dependabot.

**0.2.27 was not published to PyPI.** Its publish job expired before approval, so this is the first PyPI release since 0.2.26 and it includes everything in [0.2.27](https://github.com/QuentinFuxa/WhisperLiveKit/releases/tag/v0.2.27) (local MLX translation, bounded WebSocket sessions, per-session decoder context, the October security refresh and its fixes).

## Added
- Nemotron streaming ASR through MLX (`nemotron-mlx-asr` extra, `--backend nemotron-mlx-asr`), using mlx-audio's incremental frontend and cached encoder with the converted `mlx-community/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b` checkpoint. Sessions have independent caches and language prompts; model loading and decoding stay on one dedicated thread. (#426, thanks @clkao)

## Fixed
- A non-ASCII API token now gets 401 (REST) or the 4401 close (WebSocket) instead of HTTP 500, and a non-ASCII configured token matches itself. (#479, fixes #478, thanks @goranai)

## Maintenance and security
- Rejected requests log the client address (`client=ADDRESS`), including REST token failures and refused WebSocket upgrades, so repeated attempts can be traced or fed to fail2ban. The token is never logged. (#476, following discussion #463)
- Locked dependencies refreshed for November (Accelerate 1.16.0 in the Voxtral HF graph, Torch 2.11.0 for the `cpu` extra on macOS arm64), and the lock now covers only the platforms Torch ships wheels for (Linux x86_64 and aarch64, macOS arm64, Windows AMD64). This fixes the Dependabot update failures. Advisories still held by upstream pins (mostly `qwen-asr==0.0.6`, NeMo and Diart) are listed in `docs/dependency-audit.md`. PyPI installs are unaffected by the lock. (#480)
- Reproducible M5 backend evaluation recorded under `benchmarks/evaluations/m5-20261107/`. (#444)

## New contributors
- @goranai made their first contribution in #479.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/QuentinFuxa/WhisperLiveKit/compare/v0.2.27...v0.2.28
